effect: The excavator cleared the bay and completed the chapter, but the cave still needs breathable air before it can serve as a growing space.
reaction: The rubble pile and sound rock made the progress tangible; the reminder about air left me curious about what comes next.

mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the cavern bay was the most worthwhile moment: the excavator's repeated work produced a tangible sheltered space while making clear that shelter alone is not enough.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hopper was the least engaging moment because the result named the component but gave little detail about fitting it.

surprise.text: I expected the steel to help assemble or support the excavator, but it made a spoil hopper instead.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the hopper, power connection and excavation each had a practical purpose, even if the hopper's construction was not explained.

continue.text: Yes. I'd like to see how the cleared but airless bay becomes a usable growing space; the practical progression has kept me interested.
